correctness.rationale: The published all-index cross-difference bound and finite two-column support yield a 15-pair obstruction with unique 3-adic minimum at (2,1). Exact initial minor, induction, and first-two-coefficient transfer prove ν3(D_m)=2m+7 and the leading unit for all m≥0; a two-index elimination excludes any stronger uniform modulus. The embedded exact checker reconstructs finite arithmetic and coefficients modulo 3^30. Limits: induction uses independently inspected published lemmas, not finite testing.

value.rationale: The exact modulus for each depth and every integer multiplier is a natural and explicitly motivated optimality question left unanswered by an otherwise complete internal congruence theorem. Exact normalized leading units explain noncancellation and settle an infinite family without arbitrary parameter slicing. It also supplies a transferable exterior-square sharpness mechanism.
